sourceNote: A plain-language history of changes to StrataBase. Features shown as testing or development are not necessarily available in the main application.

releaseNotes.dateLabel: 5 November 2026
releaseNotes.summary: Find projects faster using search, sorting and country filters.
releaseNotes.limitations: In testing; features may change before general release.
changes: Find projects faster using search, sorting and country filters.
Preview factual investigation logs directly in StrataBase with Quick Log.
Review laboratory samples and open spreadsheet-style Batch Edit.
Move between Log Review, Data Review and quality checks more easily.
Improved desktop navigation and release information.
